usage: 夏天 is a noun and refers to the season of summer.
You can use 夏天 as the subject or object in sentences.
It is often used with time expressions to talk about activities or weather during summer.
夏天 can be followed by verbs or adjectives to describe what happens in summer.
When mentioning 夏天, you can also add phrases to specify different months or holidays in summer.
